dict.string: Mynah keeps its own calendar, named Mynah, and puts your dated tasks in it so your Mac, phone and watch can do the reminding. It only ever writes to that one calendar, and deleting it removes everything Mynah put there.

Mynah keeps its own calendar, named Mynah, and puts your dated tasks in it so your Mac, phone and watch can do the reminding. It only ever writes to that one calendar, and deleting it removes everything Mynah put there.

Mynah asks for the microphone only if you choose to hold the talk button and speak to it from this Mac. It never listens in the background, and what you say is turned into words on this Mac.
